description: Project general facts Sanctuary is a refined residential development set within the prestigious Meydan district, uniquely positioned beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The project's architecture reflects modern sophistication, with a sculpted façade of glass and clean geometry designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views. Sanctuary offers a rare balance between urban elegance and nature, providing residents with uninterrupted vistas of the Dubai skyline and protected natural landscapes, while remaining minutes from Downtown Dubai and major city arteries. The project features an extensive collection of resort-style amenities thoughtfully distributed across dedicated lifestyle levels. Residents enjoy landscaped serenity gardens, waterfall features, sunken island pools, infinity pools, outdoor fitness areas, kids' pools and play zones, BBQ areas, outdoor cinema, jacuzzi, spa-style relaxation pools, and sky gardens with observation decks. Indoor amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, sauna, indoor cinema, games area, and family-friendly communal spaces, creating a holistic living environment focused on wellness, leisure, and community. Interiors at Sanctuary are designed to reflect calm, comfort, and contemporary luxury. Living spaces are bright and spacious, enhanced by large windows that frame natural and skyline views. The residences are delivered without furniture, and interior specifications follow a standard of high-quality finishes with modern materials, aligned with the project's premium positioning. The overall interior concept emphasizes timeless design, functional layouts, and a serene atmosphere that complements the project's nature-inspired setting. Location description and benefits Ras Al Khor is one of Dubai's hidden gems, where urban convenience meets the untouched beauty of nature. Located just minutes from the city's bustling center, this district is best known for the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a protected reserve that is home to thousands of migratory birds, including the iconic pink flamingos. The area's unique charm lies in its serene landscapes, offering residents and visitors a peaceful retreat from the dynamic energy of Dubai while still being well-connected to major landmarks and attractions. Beyond its natural wonders, Ras Al Khor is an emerging residential and commercial hub, offering a blend of modern infrastructure and tranquil surroundings. The district features a mix of upscale developments, spacious villas, and waterfront residences, all designed to provide a harmonious balance between luxury and sustainability. With easy access to Dubai Creek, Downtown Dubai, and major road networks, Ras Al Khor ensures a seamless lifestyle that combines convenience with scenic beauty. As Dubai continues to grow, Ras Al Khor remains a testament to the city's commitment to preserving its natural heritage while embracing modern progress. Future developments in the area promise to enhance its appeal with new residential communities, leisure destinations, and cultural attractions. Whether you are drawn to its stunning wildlife sanctuary, its picturesque waterfront views, or its growing urban landscape, Ras Al Khor offers a unique living experience where nature and city life coexist in perfect harmony.

Its road connections provide access to other parts of Dubai and key economic zones, while ongoing infrastructure development supports the area's long-term potential. description: Exclusive Waterfront Apartments with Wynn Casino Views in Ras Al Khaimah Ras Al Khaimah, the northernmost emirate of the UAE, is renowned for its stunning coastline, majestic mountains, and rapidly growing luxury real estate market. This dynamic destination blends rich cultural heritage with modern infrastructure, offering residents and investors a high-quality lifestyle. One of the most anticipated developments in the region is the Wynn Al Marjan Island, the UAE's first integrated gaming and resort destination. Set to open in 2027, this mega-project will feature a world-class casino, luxury hotels, fine dining, and entertainment experiences, making Ras Al Khaimah a premier global tourism and investment hub. With its breathtaking waterfront views, expanding infrastructure, and promising economic growth, Ras Al Khaimah is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after locations in the UAE for luxury living and investment opportunities. are conveniently located just 3 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 6 minutes from Al Marjan Island Beach and Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, 13 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Corniche, 15 minutes from Wynn Casino, 25 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 55 minutes from Downtown Dubai. Designed as an exclusive waterfront community, this development seamlessly blends modern luxury with natural tranquility. It features five elegant 18-story towers, each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Wynn Al Marjan Island. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the exteriors combine earthy tones and contemporary design, creating a visually striking yet serene environment. Residents can enjoy direct sea access and an extensive array of world-class amenities, including a scenic promenade, state-of-the-art fitness center, coworking spaces, an entertainment room, multiple swimming pools, a kids' play area, jogging tracks, and championship padel tennis courts. For outdoor enthusiasts, lush parks, a dedicated pet-friendly zone with grooming services, and barbecue areas enhance the community's appeal. The development is further enriched by its proximity to the Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Golf Club, and an array of luxury hotels, fine dining, and high-end retail outlets, ensuring a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. The project offers a meticulously designed collection of residences, including spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted for modern comfort and elegance. Interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts that maximize natural light, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning sea views. High-quality finishes and premium materials create a sophisticated ambiance, complemented by neutral, earthy tones inspired by the surrounding landscape. Each residence is equipped with fitted wardrobes, ensuring ample storage space, and a fully integrated kitchen with high-end white goods, blending convenience with contemporary aesthetics. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto private balconies, offering breathtaking vistas of the Arabian Gulf. The master bedrooms are designed as serene retreats, with en-suite bathrooms featuring sleek fixtures and refined detailing. Smart home technology and energy-efficient features enhance everyday living, while spacious layouts cater to both relaxation and entertainment, creating an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. Portside Square is developed by Ellington in Mina Rashid, a historic port district that opened in 1972 and now includes a marina and cruise terminal. The Queen Elizabeth 2 is about a minute's drive away, Sheikh Zayed Road six minutes, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport around 10 minutes.

The location links Mina Rashid's maritime heritage with short drives to the city's business districts, including DIFC at about 14 minutes. Homes are offered on a freehold basis, and the project is registered with the Dubai Land Department.
